title: error inside an imported file
notes: Reports sub/imported.pdl:4, the line the expression is on. Until phase-3 item 0 it reported `sub/imported.pdl:1`: `execute_call` built the callee's location out of the callee's file and path and the CALLER's line table, the lookup missed, and `get_line`'s ancestor walk turned the miss into a confident wrong line (DROP #6). `PdlLocationType` no longer carries a table, so that location cannot be spelled; the entry is now the regression test for it. Location 1 rather than 2: the line is right, but no column, no block path and no import chain are printed.
